items.title: Joseph "Fan" Bourgeau Interview, 1972-09-13
items.q: I had Charlie Love playing trumpet, man... I was on the road with Willie Pajot and Charlie Love.

ctx.x: I heard of him. I know his top of his brother on the phone.

I got on the road with the type of things that's tough, you know? He was closing up when the district was open. You heard about the district, huh? Yeah. He was running when the district was open. No, no, no. When the district was open, I used to write a lot of y'all through the district. You know, I was used to play a lot of y'all. Plenty a lot of y'all. Well, then he closed the district down. He closed everything down. He got caught on those speakeasers, you know? So Kuyper comes and says, you want to take a…
